base_pose:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one NEW reusable children's-book base pose PNG, on genuinely transparent background, preferably 2048 x 2048 pixels. Input 1 is the primary design/style reference: bald child in a gray neutral bodysuit, gray face, dark eyebrows, round oversized head, small triangular nose, big simple eyes, subtly textured flat picture-book shapes and a restrained dark outline. Input 2 confirms the same child proportions and facial design; do NOT use its warm skin color or white background. Input 3 is ONLY scene/orientation context: a very tall slide on the RIGHT, with the child standing on the path on the LEFT. Do not include the slide or any scenery in the output.
Primary request: replace the old front-facing raised-hand pose with a full-body standing child who is clearly looking UP AND RIGHT toward a tall slide. Show the child from a three-quarter BACK/side angle, body oriented screen-right away from viewer; head tilted back around 25 degrees so upward gaze reads immediately. Keep enough of the near side of the face visible to show raised, gently worried/curious eyebrows and a tiny parted mouth. It should read 'that looks exciting, but very tall' rather than panic, sadness or waving. Child must not look at camera. Two feet planted naturally on level ground, weight slightly on back foot. Arms low and close: near hand gently holds the opposite wrist at lower chest or upper belly height, elbows relaxed, NOT one hand raised as a wave, NOT a pointing gesture. Keep the familiar toddler/young child body ratio, round head, short limbs and rounded bodysuit feet.
Invariants: complete bald head, eyebrows, no hair, no eyelashes, no gendered details, all face and body gray as in input 1, neutral gray one-piece bodysuit including hands/feet, no shirt/shorts/shoes or accessories. Same flat painted paper texture, minimal soft tonal shading, no 3D rendering. One complete isolated figure only. Leave at least 12% transparent margin around every extremity and no crop anywhere. No text, watermark, floor, cast shadow, white panel or environment. Clean transparent edges; do not draw a checkerboard pattern. Output a single pose, not a sheet or comparison.

Input image 2 is ONLY the personalized child's identity, colors, clothes and painting style reference: the same warm tan skin, short side-swept brown hair, large dark brown simple eyes, blue short-sleeve shirt, blue-gray shorts, and pale blue sneakers. Transfer this exact identity and outfit to pose 1. Do NOT copy image 2's front-facing view, waving arm or gaze toward the camera. The new child must look clearly UP AND RIGHT as in image 1, toward a tall slide outside the frame. Gently curious raised eyebrows and a tiny parted mouth, not crying or panic. Preserve familiar young-child proportions and paper-painted texture, with soft color edges instead of a heavy black outline. This is a pose preview, not a scene. Full figure from hair to both shoes, absolutely no cropping, plenty of transparent margin, ideally 2048 x 2048 pixels. One child only, no slide, environment, floor, cast shadow, text, watermark, opaque rectangle, checkerboard drawing or stray disconnected pixels. Genuine alpha transparency.
